name: weather_get_forecast
description: Fetch current conditions and a daily forecast for a coordinate from the Open-Meteo forecast API. Returns 'current' (time, temperature_2m in °C, relative_humidity_2m in %, wind_speed_10m in km/h, weather_code as a WMO code) and 'daily' (parallel arrays: time, temperature_2m_max, temperature_2m_min, precipitation_probability_max). Units are echoed in 'current_units' and 'daily_units'. Timezone is resolved from the coordinate. Requires coordinates, so resolve a place name with weather_geocode_place first.

forecast_days.description: Number of days to forecast, 1 to 16. Use 3 unless the user asks for a different range. This value is required: the URL template cannot expand without it.
